description:
This is the official video introducing the seamless heating feature of Hylex, Samsung's new cooling & heating system. This video showcases how Hylex helps deliver reliable and efficient home heating through Dual Fuel technology. As weather conditions become more unpredictable, homeowners are looking for heating systems that can maintain comfort more flexibly and efficiently across changing environments.

Hylex is designed to provide more balanced heating performance by flexibly selecting the optimal heating source based on system conditions.

Q: How does Dual Fuel system improve comfort in cold weather?
A: When combined with Samsung Hylex, A-Coil and furnace, Dual Fuel system can select between fossil fuel and electric to help enhance both comfort and energy efficiency. This flexible operation helps maintain reliable heating performance whether outdoor temperatures are extremely cold or even normal.
